inCorpusNuggets.sourceText: Great Hotel in a Great location! Had a quick stay here for two nights while in town for a concert. The hotels in a great location and easily walkable to a ton of shops and restaurants. Prior to my arrival Hayden from the concierge’s team reached out and was fantastic at making sure everything we needed was set up for our short visit.  She went over the top to make sure things were just right for our arrival. I also had a great interaction with Ryan the GM. When we checked in the front desk, team was super nice and accommodating. The staff reached out multiple times during our stay to make sure things were going well. The valet team was always prompt and friendly. We had room service for breakfast one morning, which was delicious, but didn’t have a chance to eat at the other restaurants but they look amazing. Very much looking forward to coming back and spending more time at this hotel!

inCorpusNuggets.sourceText: We wanted to watch the sunset from the rooftop but it was being maintained that day.  But on our way out, we noticed live music in the lobby.  It was a Friday.  We stopped a manager who gave us more information and offered us a seat on the comfortable couches and we ended up eating there.  The service from every single member of staff we came into contact with, was simply, superb! Of course the food was good.  The music was enjoyable and the highlight of our evening.  Kailee/Kaylee took great care of us and her attention to detail was immaculate.  Highly recommend this hotel even for us locals, we will be back!

I’ve been to a lot of venues, but SEVEN stands out as the best. If you want a night to remember, this is the place to be!

inCorpusNuggets.sourceText:
TLDR: I tried using a Resort Pass on a bad day and instead got an attitude and threatened to have the cops called on me.  After many many attempts to reach someone I finally was told I would be getting a refund (bare minimum and well deserved since I didn't use the pool) and the situation would be investigated (lip service).

Monday I arrived at the pool around 1245pm after a Dr's appointment, so I had the thing rom the blood draw, a band aid and a wonderful bruise on my arms, I did NOT look like I needed to be given a hard time, I also was not expecting one.

While being checked in I was told I would have to wear a wristband to which I said "ugh they're so tacky" and I was told it was so the staff could tell me from hotel guests...my filter was not on because I was tired, and not very nicely I said, "you think your staff is too stupid to tell otherwise?" the check in person said a couple other things including I could take the wristband off(which proves my point that it isn't necessary) and I finally just asked her name, she covered her name badge, so I then asked for her supervisor, she disappeared in the back, REMOVED HER NAMETAG, and when she came back out said she would give me a refund and that she was exercising her right to refuse service to whoever she wanted and she would call the cops if I didn't leave (no sign was posted about refusing service I also was calm as a cucumber during this whole interaction) I said fine, I'll leave but I'm going to need your supervisors contact information, I had to say this like 4 times, eventually she did magically go find his card.

She said she would issue a refund. She did not. I contacted the person who's card she gave me multiple times and multiple ways. I sent an email via the website. I also messaged and posted publicly on Instagram asking for the refund. Eventually I found someone else's email and emailed them today and they said they would issue the refund, so we'll see but after all this I have 0 reason to go back. They've only been open under 6 months and this is how the staff is?  It's only going to get worse.

inCorpusNuggets.sourceText:
Second To None Experience Stayed at Caesars Republic last month for a quick business trip & client entertainment and could not have been more impressed with the amenities, service & cleanliness.  Upon arrival, I was promptly greeted by Faye at the front desk who did an amazing job with explaining all the hours and locations of various outlets.

I stayed in room 420 and not only was it clean and still had that new hotel smell to it, but the attention to detail in the rooms from the mascot wolf in the pillows to the bottles of liquor on the shelves to the little mini-bar, these guys really have thought of it all.  The bed was super comfortable and the towels still felt brand-new.

During one of my nights, I hosted a couple of the clients I came out to see at Seven, which is their 7th floor lounge with remarkable views of Camelback Mountain & just as memorable service.  Lauren was our server and took exceptional care of myself and my clients during the few hours we were there and provided an experience that they are still talking about to this day.  We were lucky enough to watch the sunset over the mountain during our meal and while everything was delicious, I had the grapefruit glazed salmon and it was truly the best salmon I've ever had (even living in Portland and visiting Seattle & Alaska frequently).

All in all, my stay and experience at Caesars was incomparable to any other hotel I've stayed at in Scottsdale and can see why this is quickly becoming THE place to be.  I can't wait for my next trip in September!
